note: sha256 of the Microsoft-owned inputs. vendor/ is gitignored, so these hashes are the only thing in the repo that pins which bytes the extractor ran against. npm run extract refuses to touch a file whose hash does not match. A `required` file is required only for the build whose archive directory it sits in; every present file is checked.

vendor/archive/Blades/Retail/6770/dash.x.what: Blades retail build 6770 dashboard executable; holds the 28 XUIZ resource packs and the FFFE07D1 XDBF database.

vendor/archive/Blades/Retail/6770/shrdre.what: Loose shared-resource XUIZ pack that sits next to dash.xex.

vendor/archive/Blades/Devkit/6719 (7776..what: Devkit twin, build 6719. Not extracted; kept to diff a format question against a second build.
Byte-identical to the retail 6770 shrdres.xzp - the shared pack did not change between the two builds.

vendor/archive/NXE/Retail/9199/dash.xex.what: NXE retail build 9199 dashboard executable; holds 28 XUIZ resource packs (dashuisk, homepage, controlp, slots, ...) and the FFFE07D1 XDBF database.

vendor/archive/NXE/Retail/9199/shrdres.x.what: Loose shared-resource XUIZ pack next to the 9199 dash.xex (82 entries: icons, sounds, Live strings).

vendor/archive/NXE/Devkit/9199 (11626.0.what: Devkit twin of 9199, same size as retail. Not extracted; kept to diff a format question against a second signing.
Devkit 9199 shared pack. NOT byte-identical to the retail one (120,922 vs 193,336 bytes), unlike the Blades pair; not extracted.
